meta: A fixed starter sprint of compatibility fixes, updates and a health report to keep your WooCommerce plugin running. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Keep your WooCommerce plugin working with a care sprint
overview: WooCommerce, WordPress and PHP all release updates several times a year, and each one can break an older plugin. In this one-time sprint we test your plugin on the latest versions, fix warnings and bugs, update libraries and tested-up-to headers, look through support requests for patterns and send a short health report. Ongoing monthly care is quoted separately.

faq: No. This is a fixed starter sprint with a clear start and end. If you want regular care afterwards, we quote a monthly plan separately, based on what the health report shows.
What do you need access to?
Your plugin code and, if possible, a copy of the support tickets or issues. For testing we use our own staging sites, so we do not need a live store or any passwords.
What if my plugin is on WordPress.org?
We prepare the release package and changelog, and you or we upload it using your own account. WordPress.org reviews and plugin team rules apply, and we work within them.
Can you fix a plugin that crashes sites?
Usually yes. A fatal error is often one deprecated function or a version clash. Send the error message and when it began, and we confirm the fit before you order.
